name: Pipeliners - City Pages Batch 1 Briefs 2026-09-30
body:
> Plan · Pipeliners · 2026-09-30

# Summary
Read-only improvement briefs for 9 city pages last edited in August (so changes would not disturb the September edits being measured Oct 13 and Oct 26). Data: GSC via Search Atlas, Jun 30 to Sep 28; volumes not validated (lookup quota used up). All 9 scored "2, Needs refresh".

# Order (closest to page one first)
Coolidge, Maricopa, Litchfield Park, Paradise Valley, Casa Grande, Peoria, Cave Creek, Anthem, Glendale.

# Rules applied to every page
Title and meta in OTTO; "Pipeliners" not "Pipeliners USA"; ski-ramp structure with question H2s; local proof from Pipeliners only (no invented jobs or reviews); no unconfirmed claims; contextual links to the matching service page and 2-3 nearby cities; FAQ schema matching visible text; record go-live dates; replace the shared heading "Looking for a Pipe Repair Company Serving [City] Arizona?".

# Examples
- **Coolidge:** primary "sewer line repair coolidge az" (24 impressions, position 16); title "Sewer Line Repair & Repiping in Coolidge, AZ | Pipeliners"; H2 outline from sewer repair to hidden leaks.
- **Maricopa:** primary "sewer lining maricopa az" (42, position 18); new H1 "Trenchless Sewer Lining & Repair in Maricopa, AZ"; manhole and commercial only if confirmed (later confirmed NOT offered).

# Status
Per the handoff, Batch 1 Elementor rewrites went live through Kim's Chrome on Sep 29 for all 9 pages, with H1, OTTO title and FAQ schema follow-ups handed to Kim. Note the brief predates Oct 1: it allows "pipe lining" wording and repiping H2s that later rules restrict.
